about.title: About me
paragraphs: I am a computer science engineer at Wazuh. I work on SIEM, XDR, and intrusion detection systems. I graduated in computer engineering from the University of Granada with a focus on computing and intelligent systems.
I build skills through practice and take on tasks that stretch what I know. I stay disciplined about learning and put in the work on hard problems.
At university I built projects in deep learning, machine learning, data science, game development, cybersecurity, and web development. I work proactively and like to learn.

thesis.title: Thesis
thesis.description: Interactive 3D view of elliptic curves through the Hopf fibration. You can explore 18 torus shapes in lattice, wavy, and exotic groups. The app has 12 color modes, 6 materials, 3 animations, and full control of parameters. I built it with Three.js for my thesis on elliptic curve cryptography.

description: Architected multi-node Wazuh and OpenSearch deployments on premises, in cloud, and on AWS EKS, EC2 or ECS when it was outside Kubernetes. Spread pod and index replicas across availability zones around one master for configuration, enrollment, and the API, and added workers so agents reconnect after a worker failure.

Tuned pipelines that processed more than 250B events when ingest lagged, by changing analysisd queue depth, decode threads, and rule-matching threads, Filebeat bulk size and workers, and indexer throughput.
Reduced AWS EKS cost by up to 20% for equivalent multi-pod Wazuh environments by moving workloads from ARM to AMD and right-sizing the nodes.
Restored security visibility and cluster stability for enterprise customers after critical failures in ingestion, disk pressure, persistent volumes, and indexer health.

Kept the clusters highly available across availability zones and watched ingest lag, analysisd queue usage, disk pressure, and indexer health. Versioned EKS platform changes in GitHub so a failed release could return to the previous commit, and released detection-content changes only after a backup, a test, and a change window.

Maintained the Wazuh public integrations repository as core maintainer, and shipped rules, decoders, IOC lookup, alert enrichment, threat intelligence feeds, active-response scripts, SCA policies, and custom integrations for AWS (SQS, CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs), Azure (Microsoft Graph), Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, LDAP, FortiGate, Sophos, and Cisco.

Built Wazuh response playbooks in which a rule correlates events in a timeframe on a shared field, an IOC or enrichment script adds context, and a timed active-response command binds to specific targets. Integrations send the notifications, the analyst isolates the host or changes the account, and alert quality comes from thresholds, grouping, and exceptions for known automation after a check of the benign case.

Wrote SCA baselines mapped to PCI-DSS, CJIS, and ISO 27001 and assigned them by agent group, and ingested device logs with rsyslog over TCP and TLS into a load balancer kept internal in an air-gapped VPC, where a proxy allowlist permits package updates and the vulnerability CTI feed.
Provided IT consulting and technical support across the organization.
Built a custom desktop app to streamline daily workflows.
Deployed MFA, endpoint protection, and anti-phishing controls.
Ran training sessions so users could adopt new systems and security rules.

items.details: Focus on computing and intelligent systems. Coursework includes AI, machine learning, networking, C++, Python, OOP, OpenGL, and cybersecurity. Honors in calculus, statistics, machine learning, and programming.
Final year abroad. Coursework includes computer vision, deep learning for medical imaging, cybersecurity, real-time operating systems in C, and cloud computing.

items.name: Potocolom Studio
items.description: Open source, real-time generative image platform. Sketch on a canvas and a diffusion model paints over your strokes live, then one click hands the result to a heavier model for the final render. Generate, enhance, and upscale are built in. One AGPL codebase runs self-hosted on your own GPU, or as a managed subscription cloud. SvelteKit, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, and CUDA/ROCm.

items.name: Elliptic Curve Visualization
items.description: Interactive plot of elliptic curves (y² = x³ + ax + b) with adjustable parameters and zoom. Part of my thesis on elliptic curve cryptography. Built in C++ and run in Docker.

items.name: Cypher - Encrypted Chat App
items.description: Encrypted chat app with end-to-end encryption, real-time messaging, and no metadata storage. It uses TLS, Signal-style protocols, and AES. Users stay anonymous by design.

items.name: Self-Hosted Nextcloud
items.description: Private file sync and storage on Docker and Traefik. Part of a homelab where I control my own data instead of using cloud drives.

items.name: Classifying Mushrooms
items.description: Supervised models that classify mushroom edibility from the UCI Secondary Mushroom dataset. Course project at the University of Granada.

items.name: AI for Ludo Game
items.description: Parchís variant with a deliberative AI agent. It uses MINIMAX and alpha-beta pruning to play against humans.

items.name: Visual Path Finding
items.description: Interactive demo of path-finding algorithms such as A* and Dijkstra. Built as a teaching aid for algorithm behavior.

items.name: Pichola - Award-Winning Game
